name: campusconnect
description: CampusConnect - Student Welfare Management System (DBMS course project, Group-15)

scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate --workspace db && npm run import --workspace db && npm run seed --workspace db
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
